name: Wind turbine aeroelastic benchmark dataset
description: Develops computational and experimental benchmark data specifically intended to validate and compare wind turbine aeroelastic algorithms.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MSE (reconstruction error) and spectral similarity metrics
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark used in wind-energy and aeroelastic research for validating simulation and analysis methods, with modest community adoption.
notes: Contains experimental and computational aeroelastic data; relatively small and domain-specific dataset; not suitable for LLM evaluation; requires domain expertise and specialized preprocessing.
